payload.core_composition_summary: Monotonic stack computes k-intervals; greedy two-pointer assignment determines valid k.
payload.rationale: Solution uses monotonic stack to precompute for each element the range of k where it acts as minimum, then greedily assigns values to window lengths via two-pointer sweep.
